(()=>{"use strict";const niche=document.getElementById("niche-filter"),type=document.getElementById("type-filter"),query=document.getElementById("search-filter"),cards=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".research-row")),count=document.getElementById("results-count"),empty=document.getElementById("empty-state"),expand=document.getElementById("expand-results");const norm=s=>s.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"").toLowerCase();function updateExpand(){const visible=cards.filter(c=>!c.hidden);expand.textContent=visible.length&&visible.every(c=>c.open)?"Fechar todos os detalhes":"Abrir todos os detalhes";expand.disabled=!visible.length}function filter(){let shown=0;const q=norm(query.value.trim());cards.forEach(card=>{const ns=card.dataset.niches.split(" "),ts=card.dataset.types.split(" ");const matchN=niche.value==="todos"||ns.includes(niche.value)||(niche.value==="estetica"&&ns.includes("estetica_medica"));const matchT=type.value==="todos"||ts.includes(type.value);const matchQ=!q||norm(card.dataset.search).includes(q);card.hidden=!(matchN&&matchT&&matchQ);if(!card.hidden)shown++});count.textContent=shown+" de "+cards.length+" registros";empty.hidden=shown!==0;document.querySelector(".table-labels").hidden=shown===0;updateExpand()}function reset(){niche.value="todos";type.value="todos";query.value="";filter()}niche.addEventListener("change",filter);type.addEventListener("change",filter);query.addEventListener("input",filter);document.getElementById("reset-filters").addEventListener("click",reset);document.getElementById("reset-empty").addEventListener("click",reset);expand.addEventListener("click",()=>{const visible=cards.filter(c=>!c.hidden),shouldOpen=!visible.every(c=>c.open);visible.forEach(c=>c.open=shouldOpen);updateExpand()});cards.forEach(c=>c.addEventListener("toggle",updateExpand));filter()})();
